hostToken.description: The scoped token returned by POST /v1/hosts, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Identifies this registered host; do not substitute the server API token.

invocationToken.description: The invocation-scoped services token Brain supplies to an Environment executing an agent loop, tool or controller. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>; valid only for the granted services while that execution is open.

reporterToken.description: The reporter token Brain supplies to an Environment instance, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Scoped to the session, environment name and incarnation sequence in the URL.

serverToken.description: The server's BRAIN_API_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required for application API calls when configured; optional only on a loopback server started without a token.
